headline.purpose: Case-view heading with documented narrow-screen overrides.

outcome.purpose: Recorded synthetic outcome, with the narrow Results override.

passage.purpose: Source extraction text with a more open line height.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
motion.purpose: Applies to the case shell and descendants; no duration or easing token is introduced.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Burgundy action used to advance guided preparation.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid #b6b6c0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 13px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--case-accent, #7a0f2a); border-color: var(--case-accent, #7a0f2a); color: #ffffff; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #5f0b20; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #966a09; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Paper control for explicit saving and supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid #b6b6c0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 13px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; background: #ffffff; color: var(--case-ink, #202027); } .ds-secondary:hover { background: var(--case-surface, #fafafb); border-color: var(--case-accent, #7a0f2a); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #966a09; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Case Text Field
components.description: Visible label and editable case detail on white.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Case name<input type="text" value="Fictional deposit dispute"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 550; color: var(--case-ink, #202027); } .ds-field input { font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--case-ink, #202027); border: 1px solid #b9b9c4; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; caret-color: var(--case-accent, #7a0f2a); max-width: 100%; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #966a09; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Case Destination
components.description: Text and stroke icon with the current destination selected.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 5px; } .ds-nav button { font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--case-ink, #202027); padding: 12px 10px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--case-accent-soft, #f3e9ed); color: var(--case-accent, #7a0f2a); font-weight: 650; } .ds-nav button:hover { filter: brightness(.96); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #966a09; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Source Reference

narrative.overview:
The case workspace uses white reading surfaces, ink text, burgundy actions, and quiet gray dividers. One sans-serif stack keeps navigation, explanations, and preserved source passages in the same visual language. The existing TrialLens mark remains the identity asset.

The visual hierarchy supports close reading: restrained panels identify outcomes and warnings, while source references stay beside the explanations that cite them. Status words and saved-state feedback remain visible. The design does not turn a synthetic outcome into a prediction or a source reference into a finding of truth.
keyCharacteristics: Burgundy primary actions and selected destinations on white and pale gray surfaces.
Compact controls with generous reading space and wrapping source text.
Flat containers, light borders, and tonal emphasis instead of decorative shadows.
Visible warnings, keyboard focus, and an explicit Save action.

rules.name: The Meaningful Accent Rule
rules.body: Use burgundy for primary actions, the current destination, and source references. Keep warnings and completion states in their observed semantic colors.

rules.name: The Reading Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Keep source passages at the body size with the more open passage line height; do not compress them to metadata size.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate the case rail, result, and source with borders, spacing, and pale surfaces. The guided workspace adds no decorative box shadows.

dos: Do use the existing TrialLens mark and the documented burgundy, white, ink, and sans-serif system.
Do keep source references adjacent to the recorded reason and preserve an obvious way back from source inspection.
Do show warning text, attempt status, valid-ballot counts, and the simulation limitation alongside the relevant content.
Do keep visible focus, accessible control labels, and the explicit Save action with truthful saved, unsaved, saving, and failed states.
Do allow long case names, citations, passages, and hashes to wrap within their available space.
donts: Don't present an incomplete attempt as a completed decision or a synthetic ballot distribution as a real-world verdict probability.
Don't remove source or extraction warnings to make a result appear cleaner.
Don't use new decorative imagery in place of preserved documents or replace the existing identity asset.
Don't transfer historical advanced-workflow eyebrows or compact status typography into the new workspace's reusable hierarchy.
